methodology: Same fresh in-memory corpus for four request variants. Reuses the existing ten diagnostic prompts and inherited name-based oracles, not held out. Known-target anchors use oracle knowledge and are a control, not a fair automatic-retrieval score. Larger budget changes traversal selection/representation caps as well as available tokens. Wrappers observe search results and neighbor results before representation generation; these are not the final candidate/ranking sets and cannot by themselves identify why a symbol was dropped. Trials do not edit code or execute fixture/application tests. Timings are single-run and order/cache dependent. No models or network calls.
